dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures in the upper-left dorsal region show irregular, high-contrast dark perimeters transitioning abruptly to light-grey interiors; one 'C' shaped structure on the upper right exhibits a similar sharp dark-to-light gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters is concentrated on the lower right flank; a moderate density of small, solid low-intensity dark blobs is scattered across the mid-dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distal macro-annuli in the upper dorsal section form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a series of four dark blobs forms a near-linear arrangement along the lateral-dorsal boundary.
